entries.title: Matthew 25:1
segments: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

entries.title: Matthew 25:2
segments: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

entries.title: Matthew 25:3
segments: For the foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them:

entries.title: Matthew 25:4
segments: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

entries.title: Matthew 25:5
segments: Now while the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

entries.title: Matthew 25:6
segments: But at midnight there is a cry, Behold, the bridegroom! Come ye forth to meet him.

entries.title: Matthew 25:7
segments: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

entries.title: Matthew 25:8
segments: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are going out.

entries.title: Matthew 25:9
segments: But the wise answered, saying, Peradventure there will not be enough for us and you: go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

entries.title: Matthew 25:10
segments: And while they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and the door was shut.

entries.title: Matthew 25:11
segments: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

entries.title: Matthew 25:12
segments: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

entries.title: Matthew 25:13
segments: Watch therefore, for ye know not the day nor the hour.

entries.title: Matthew 25:14
segments: For [it is] as [when] a man, going into another country, called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

entries.title: Matthew 25:15
segments: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his several ability; and he went on his journey.

entries.title: Matthew 25:16
segments: Straightway he that received the five talents went and traded with them, and made other five talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:17
segments: In like manner he also that [received] the two gained other two.

entries.title: Matthew 25:18
segments: But he that received the one went away and digged in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

entries.title: Matthew 25:19
segments: Now after a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and maketh a reckoning with them.

entries.title: Matthew 25:20
segments: And he that received the five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: lo, I have gained other five talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:21
segments: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

entries.title: Matthew 25:22
segments: And he also that [received] the two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: lo, I have gained other two talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:23
segments: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will set thee over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy lord.

entries.title: Matthew 25:24
segments: And he also that had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art a hard man, reaping where thou didst not sow, and gathering where thou didst not scatter;

entries.title: Matthew 25:25
segments: and I was afraid, and went away and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, thou hast thine own.

entries.title: Matthew 25:26
segments: But his lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter;

entries.title: Matthew 25:27
segments: thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back mine own with interest.

entries.title: Matthew 25:28
segments: Take ye away therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him that hath the ten talents.

entries.title: Matthew 25:29
segments: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away.

entries.title: Matthew 25:30
segments: And cast ye out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

entries.title: Matthew 25:31
segments: But when the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the angels with him, then shall he sit on the throne of his glory:

entries.title: Matthew 25:32
segments: and before him shall be gathered all the nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as the shepherd separateth the sheep from the goats;

entries.title: Matthew 25:33
segments: and he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

entries.title: Matthew 25:34
segments: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

entries.title: Matthew 25:35
segments: for I was hungry, and ye gave me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink; I was a stranger, and ye took me in;

entries.title: Matthew 25:36
segments: naked, and ye clothed me; I was sick, and ye visited me; I was in prison, and ye came unto me.

entries.title: Matthew 25:37
segments: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, and fed thee? or athirst, and gave thee drink?

entries.title: Matthew 25:38
segments: And when saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?

entries.title: Matthew 25:39
segments: And when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?

entries.title: Matthew 25:40
segments: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it unto one of these my brethren, [even] these least, ye did it unto me.

entries.title: Matthew 25:41
segments: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels:

entries.title: Matthew 25:42
segments: for I was hungry, and ye did not give me to eat; I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink;

entries.title: Matthew 25:43
segments: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in; naked, and ye clothed me not; sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.

entries.title: Matthew 25:44
segments: Then shall they also answer, saying, Lord, when saw we thee hungry, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?

entries.title: Matthew 25:45
segments: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not unto one of these least, ye did it not unto me.

entries.title: Matthew 25:46
segments: And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.
